d:
In the Indian judicial system, the Chief Justice of India is the “Master of the Roster”, with the power to allocate cases to different benches. But how extensive is this discretion, and how consistently is it exercised? We examine the data to study the exercise of the Master of the Roster’s power in the Supreme Court. Watch this week's with Gokul K. Sunoj, Founding Lawyer at TheProfesseer.
